title: EasySell
description: Sell any container instantly! Just Shift + Break with an Axe/Pickaxe.
body:
# EasySell: Shift, Strike, Profit! 🪓⛏️

**The fastest selling system! Just hold Shift and break any container with an Axe/Pickaxe to instantly sell its contents.**

![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4f0e2fcee4befcc3b688011e32925804aa99358f.jpeg)

![2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5ceae6171487034f616e8db7bd6618c4a044c89f.jpeg)

![3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/90af5e7b08b4111deb9898d81e5465ba9f8877d8.jpeg)

---

### Features:
* **⚡ Shift-to-Sell:** No commands needed, just physical action.
* **🔄 Toggle Feature:** Use `/easysell` to enable or disable the sell mode.
* **📦 All Containers:** Supports Chests and Shulker Boxes.
* **💰 Instant Payouts:** Full Vault integration.

### Commands & Permissions:
* `/easysell` - Toggle the selling mode.
* `easysell.use` - Permission required to sell items.
